# Junos `security zones ... host-inbound-traffic system-services` token
# enumeration, extracted VERBATIM from Juniper's PUBLISHED YANG SCHEMA.
#
# This file is the ORACLE for the `system-services` allowlist and for the
# `system-services all` union (#3226). It exists because the union was wrong
# three times when the oracle was a hand-transcribed list copied out of prose
# documentation pages: those pages are demonstrably incomplete and mutually
# inconsistent (one omits `lsping`, another omits `sip`, several omit
# `appqoe` / `tcp-encap` / `lsselfping` / `high-availability`). The YANG module
# is the schema the CLI itself validates against, so it is COMPLETE by
# construction and carries a stated release.
#
# Source module   junos-es-conf-security@2024-01-01.yang
#                 (junos-es = the SRX / vSRX platform family)
# YANG revision   2024-01-01, description "Junos: 24.4R2.25"
# Grouping        zone-system-services-object-type -> leaf name -> type enumeration
# Upstream        https://github.com/Juniper/yang
#                 24.4/24.4R2/native/conf-and-rpcs/junos-es/conf/models/
#                 junos-es-conf-security@2024-01-01.yang
# sha256(module)  3d03d81b1ac2041c070610c9708f74c3bc67c6d26790d4fe2509b63d5d3bd70e
#
# Cross-checks performed at extraction time:
#   * The sibling grouping `interface-system-services-object-type` (the
#     per-interface override, `security zones <z> interfaces <i>
#     host-inbound-traffic system-services`) enumerates the IDENTICAL 37 tokens.
#     Zone-level and interface-level therefore share one oracle.
#   * 25.4R1 (junos-es-conf-security@2025-01-01.yang) enumerates the SAME 37
#     tokens - the set is stable at and beyond the 24.4 target.
#   * 20.4R1 (junos-es-conf-security@2019-01-01.yang) enumerates 36 - identical
#     except that `lsselfping` had not yet been added. Nothing was ever REMOVED,
#     so a token here is not a post-24.4 novelty.
#
# Regenerate (network required; the extraction is deterministic):
#
#   U=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Juniper/yang/master/24.4/24.4R2
#   U=$U/native/conf-and-rpcs/junos-es/conf/models
#   curl -sSLo /tmp/j.yang "$U/junos-es-conf-security%402024-01-01.yang"
#   python3 - <<'EOF'
#   import re
#   ls=open('/tmp/j.yang').read().split('\n')
#   s=next(i for i,l in enumerate(ls)
#          if re.match(r'\s*grouping zone-system-services-object-type\s*\{',l))
#   d=0
#   for e in range(s,len(ls)):
#       d+=ls[e].count('{')-ls[e].count('}')
#       if d==0 and e>s: break
#   print('\n'.join(re.findall(r'^\s*enum "([^"]+)"','\n'.join(ls[s:e+1]),re.M)))
#   EOF
#
# FORMAT: one token per line, in YANG declaration order. Blank lines and lines
# whose first non-space character is `#` are ignored. `all` and `any-service`
# are the two META tokens (they name no single service); the parser in
# host_inbound_tokens_test.go separates them from the concrete services.
#
# DO NOT hand-edit to make a test pass. If xpf disagrees with this file, either
# xpf is wrong or the target release changed - in which case regenerate the file
# from the new release's module and update the provenance header above.
all
bootp
dhcp
dhcpv6
dns
finger
ftp
ident-reset
http
https
ike
netconf
ping
rlogin
reverse-telnet
reverse-ssh
rpm
rsh
snmp
snmp-trap
ssh
telnet
traceroute
xnm-ssl
xnm-clear-text
tftp
lsping
lsselfping
ntp
sip
r2cp
webapi-clear-text

tcp-encap
